connected_observations.observation: The observer calls ClosureMeshes::window and searches for the leaf-kind primary before queuing its presented marker or children. On a vacant cache entry, compile_window_leaf returns before the iterator calls meshes.add or the entry is inserted; a returned compile error therefore precedes those native asset additions in this function. Positive finite LeafDimensions feed the compiler. LeadedGlass attempts a Glass cuboid; TimberShutter computes a board count and attempts InteriorTimber cuboids. Builder retains a construction error until into_meshes. On normal successful compilation, and assuming a nonzero board count, Glass produces Glass and the six local shutter normals include non-endgrain InteriorTimber faces because grain_axis returns a cardinal axis. The exact private cache method only inserts that compiled batch collection.

It does not cover native asset deletion, panic/allocation failure, externally modified resources, renderer behavior, arbitrary alternate producers, or all Bevy error/observer lifecycle semantics. No test or runtime pass is asserted; q2251 remains open for its broader asset-lifetime/atomicity policy.
